description: This file is a shell script related to git, specifically for rewriting revision history via the 'git filter-branch' command. It includes functions, usage instructions, configuration, and logic for performing complex history rewriting operations in a Git repository.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps original commit identifiers to rewritten ones using a stored mapping.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by mapping its parents, used in commit filtering.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree has changes; skips the commit otherwise.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Ensures author/committer identity variables are non-empty and exported.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Sets author and committer identities based on commit info.
